tools.name: audit_receipt
tools.description: Create a stateless SHA-256 digest of supplied inputs, findings, and source revision. It is not a trusted signature or legal attestation. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/audit/receipt. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: audit_integrity-receipt
tools.description: Hash a caller-supplied evaluation and payload, repeat the caller-supplied timestamp, and score whether the declared fields and optional payload checksum are present. The same input always produces the same hash. The receipt is not a signature. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/audit/integrity-receipt.
